did_you_know.title: Detroit Riots: In Detroit, one of the worst riots in United States history begin…
did_you_know.text: Detroit Riots: In Detroit, one of the worst riots in United States history begins on 12th Street in the predominantly African American inner city. It ultimately kills 43 people, injures 342 and burns about 1,400 buildings.
